mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_program_params (project_id, file_path, engine, datasources, jar_dependency_catalogs, run_params, compute_resources, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{entity.projectId}, #{entity.filePath}, #{entity.engine}, #{entity.datasources}, #{entity.jarDependencyCatalogs}, #{entity.runParams}, #{entity.computeResources}, #{entity.remark}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE engine = #{entity.engine}, datasources = #{entity.datasources}, jar_dependency_catalogs = #{entity.jarDependencyCatalogs}, run_params = #{entity.runParams}, compute_resources = #{entity.computeResources}, remark = #{entity.remark}, update_time = NOW()
